note: One entry per fact a rule can require. VITA never invents a follow-up question: it asks the question attached to the fact that is currently blocking the most urgent unresolved rule, which is why every question can be traced back to a rule id. `askable: false` marks facts that are established from records rather than from the patient.

chest_pain.text: Are you having any pain or discomfort in your chest?

breathing_difficulty.text: Are you finding it hard to breathe, or feeling short of breath?

pain_radiating.text: Does the pain spread anywhere else, such as into your arm, jaw, neck or back?

sweating.text: Have you been sweating heavily, or breaking into a cold sweat?

nausea.text: Do you feel sick or nauseated, or have you vomited?

fainting.text: Have you fainted, blacked out, or felt like you were about to?

severity.text: On a scale of nought to ten, where ten is the worst pain you can imagine, how bad is it right now?

known_cardiac_history.text: Have you ever been told you have a heart condition, or had a heart attack before?

onset_hours.text: When did this start? You can answer in hours or days.

pain_on_breathing.text: Does the pain get worse when you breathe in deeply or cough?

pain_reproducible_on_pressure.text: If you press on the painful spot with your fingers, does that reproduce the same pain?

fever.text: Do you have a fever, or have you been feeling hot and shivery?

temperature_c.text: Have you measured your temperature? If so, what was the reading?

duration_days.text: How many days have you had this for?

neck_stiffness.text: Is your neck stiff or painful when you try to bend your chin to your chest?

rash_non_blanching.text: Do you have a rash? If you press a glass against it, does the rash stay visible?

confusion.text: Have you felt confused or unusually drowsy, or has anyone said you seem confused?

immunocompromised.text: Are you receiving chemotherapy, taking steroids or immune-suppressing medication, or have you been told your immune system is weakened?

speaking_full_sentences.text: Can you say a full sentence out loud without stopping to catch your breath?

lips_blue.text: Have your lips or fingertips turned blue or grey?

sudden_onset.text: Did this come on suddenly, over seconds or minutes, rather than gradually?

known_asthma.text: Do you have asthma or another diagnosed lung condition?

wheezing.text: Is there a whistling or wheezing sound when you breathe?

injury.text: Did something happen to cause this, such as a fall, a blow or an accident?

bleeding_uncontrolled.text: Are you bleeding, and does it keep bleeding even when you press firmly on it?

loss_of_consciousness.text: Did you lose consciousness at any point, even briefly?

on_anticoagulants.text: Do you take any blood-thinning medication, such as warfarin, aspirin, apixaban or clopidogrel?

mechanism_high_energy.text: Was this a road accident, a fall from a height, or something of similar force?

deformity_visible.text: Does the injured part look bent, out of shape, or obviously wrong?

can_bear_weight.text: Can you stand and put weight on it, or use it normally?

abdominal_pain.text: Do you have pain in your stomach or belly?

rigid_abdomen.text: Is your stomach hard and tense, and does gentle pressure make the pain much worse?

vomiting_blood.text: Have you vomited blood, or something that looked like coffee grounds?

black_stool.text: Have your stools been black and tarry, or contained blood?

pregnancy.text: Is there any chance you might be pregnant?

sudden_severe_onset.text: Did the pain start suddenly and severely, rather than building up gradually?

testicular_pain.text: Is there any pain or swelling in the testicles?

prior_visit_72h_same_complaint.text: Have you been seen here in the last three days for this same problem?
prior_visit_72h_same_complaint.note: Normally established from the patient's prior visits rather than asked, but askable as a fallback when no record is found.
